# Counter-Strike: Source v34 SDK subset

This directory contains the practical build-4044 subset required by the ART V1.0 DLL:

- `public/` headers and small support sources
- `tier0.lib`, `vstdlib.lib`, `tier1.lib`, `tier2.lib`, `mathlib.lib`, and `bitmap.lib`

The full SDK, game source, samples, and tools are intentionally omitted. Upstream copyright notices are preserved. These files are not covered by the ART MIT license; the supplied notice states **NOT FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES**. See [UPSTREAM_README.md](UPSTREAM_README.md).
